item.title: Olympic art project in a Milan park invites the public to ‘reflect’ on the Games’ spirit
item.description: MILAN (AP) — “Together to Reflect” was conceived as a collective artwork that takes shape as slender stakes topped with mirrors, on which people write their thoughts about sports and the Games. The post Olympic art project in a Milan park invites the public to ‘reflect’ on the Games’ spirit appeared first on RNS.

item.title: Israel’s security cabinet approves measures to strengthen control over the West Bank
item.description: JERUSALEM (AP) — The office of far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich in a statement announced the decisions that would make it easier for Jewish settlers to force Palestinians to give up land, adding that “we will continue to bury the idea of a Palestinian state.” The post Israel’s security cabinet approves measures to strengthen control over the West Bank appeared first on RNS.

item.title: White Christian support for Trump falls but still tops that of Americans overall
item.description: (RNS) — A new Pew Research survey found that Trump’s approval ratings have dropped among major religious groups. But white Christians support the president more than other Americans. The post White Christian support for Trump falls but still tops that of Americans overall appeared first on RNS.

item.title: As Walk for Peace reaches DC, Buddhist monks share interfaith message with thousands
item.description: WASHINGTON (RNS) — Dominga Hobbs, who lives in Colombia and lost her husband in the past year, said, ‘I’m here for me, for my family, and to honor the monks for this extraordinary effort.
